subject.title: fix: preserve selected GitHub skills across resync

question: Should ClawHub persist selected GitHub skill paths on githubSkillSources and treat an absent selection as legacy all-skills mode?
rationale: This changes the durable source-selection contract and upgrade behavior for existing GitHub-backed sources, which automation cannot decide as a product policy choice.

options.title: Accept Persisted Selections
options.body: Keep selectedSkillPaths as the source contract, preserve absent selection as legacy all-skills mode, and fix the admin dry-run inconsistency before merge.

options.title: Require Explicit All-vs-Selected Mode
options.body: Revise the model or UI so all-skills and selected-skills are represented explicitly instead of overloading an absent field for legacy behavior.

options.title: Pause Source Selection
options.body: Keep the PR draft or close it until maintainers decide whether subset sync belongs in this settings flow.

recommendation.title: Accept Persisted Selections
recommendation.body: Keep selectedSkillPaths as the source contract, preserve absent selection as legacy all-skills mode, and fix the admin dry-run inconsistency before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and recently maintained the GitHub-backed source sync contract that this PR extends.
